message: 🚨 ALERT: Duplicate payment charges detected. 5 orders double-charged in last 2 minutes.
This is a payment issue during the flash sale. Duplicate charges are going out. Looking at payment-service now.

The idempotency check is application-level — it reads from the DB, checks if the order has been charged, then writes. Under high concurrency, two threads can both read 'not charged' before either writes.
Classic TOCTOU race. How many customers affected so far?
32 duplicate charges. Total overcharge ~$4,800. I can add a UNIQUE constraint on (order_id, charge_status) to the payments table as an immediate fix.
Do it. We'll get ConflictErrors on the duplicates but that's better than double-charging.
UNIQUE constraint in place. No more duplicates. Starting automated refund for the 32 affected orders.
All 32 refunds processed. Customers notified via email.
